profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. describes itself as a website building platform. Its site says it offers a free, easy-to-use website builder with 2,000+ templates, built-in AI tools, and a custom domain. The company also states that users can sell products, services, and memberships from one dashboard with zero plugins.

On the AI side, Wix's own site highlights built-in AI tools and specialized AI agents that it says help keep a business growing. No specific AI product names beyond these general descriptions appear in the available material.

The company is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv, trading under the ticker WIX, with SEC CIK number 0001576789. No lawsuits are listed for the company.
